Ethridge House by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Have a big family? Book “Family Ties” just down the block at 76 Montgomery Street. Booking both houses ensures you’ll have exclusive access to the private beach: Just thirty steps from the water! Sugar-white sand: just 300 feet away. Your own heated pool: out back, waiting. Ethridge House brings the good stuff without making a big fuss about it. Set in laid-back Seagrove Beach, this two-story hideaway makes a solid case for doing less (but enjoying more).

The first floor has three comfy bedrooms, a second living area with a wet bar (midnight snacks encouraged), and a laundry room that’s actually big enough to be useful. Step outside to the private pool and patio, ideal for cannonballs, cocktails, or both. Very nice. Upstairs, the kitchen is open, airy, and fully prepped for everything from pancake stacks to fresh-caught dinners. The main living and dining areas are right there, along with a balcony that practically insists on evening drinks. Four bikes are ready to roll, and 30A is your playground. Ride the Timpoochee Trail, stop for tacos, browse a boutique, wander into Seaside or Rosemary without a plan. It’s all within reach… and better by bike! At Oversee 30A, we’re your behind-the-scenes crew. Questions, tips, little hiccups? We’re here, day or night, to make sure your vacation feels like a vacation. Overview: - 100 steps to Greenwood Public Beach Access - 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths - 2,450 sq. ft. - Oversized kitchen on the second floor - Private heated pool (pool can be heated seasonally for an additional $55.00 per day, contact Oversee for details) - Parking for 3 vehicles (no garage access) - Wi-Fi - TVs in every bedroom and living area Overnight: FIRST FLOOR - Guest Room 1: 2 twin beds, shared hallway bath, TV - Guest Room 2: 2 twin beds, shared hallway bath - Guest Room 3: Queen bed, private bath, shower, TV SECOND FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: King bed, Gulf views, balcony access, private bath w/dual vanity and shower, TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
